name: zindex_archive_read_file_by_name
description: zIndexArchive::ReadFileByName finds a ZAR record by case-insensitive name, publishes the required size, reports too-small buffers, and reads payload bytes from the archive file.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 /MD byte verification for 0x4a6670 passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking; relocation bytes masked: 12.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a6670 validates FindRecordByNameCI dispatch, 0x10001 for absent records, publishing record->fileSize through *bufferSize, 0x10002 for too-small buffers, SetFilePointer to record->fileOffset, ReadFile of record->fileSize bytes, and return 0 on read path.
The native archive wave smoke verifies the too-small buffer return and required-size update, then verifies successful payload read through ReadFileByName and a downstream zSndWaveData archive parse.
